_comment: By-DOI rescue manifest, read by build-data.mjs (rescueMissingWorks) in every daily build. Papers listed or discovered here are fetched from Crossref BY DOI and folded into the harvest when the journal-route listing (/journals/<issn>/works) misses them — Crossref can serve a record by DOI that its journal index never returns. Per journal key: 'dois' = explicit bare DOIs to top up (a DOI Crossref cannot resolve is reported and skipped — that is how a suspected-missing DOI is safely probed; it may just be someone's bad reference); 'scans' = {volume} specs resolved against OpenAlex each build (works?filter=locations.source.issn,biblio.volume) so the DOI list self-heals — a scan-found DOI is only accepted when the fetched record's own volume matches. Found by lit/_scraper/coverage-audit.mjs: Operations Research vol 67 (2019) is missing issue 2 entirely plus most of issue 4 (~35 papers) from the journal-route harvest, and 10.1287/mnsc.2014.1882 is cited by a catalog paper but absent (unconfirmed — the probe decides).
